name: de2bi
expr: b = de2bi(d); bb = de2bi(10, [], 3); bn = de2bi(10, 4, 3); r1=double(size(bb,2)); r2=double(bb(1,1)); r3=double(bb(1,3)); r4=double(size(bn,2));
comment: Sig: b = de2bi(d[, n[, base[, flag]]]). Legacy decimal->binary, each int -> one row, default base 2 right-msb, auto width from max. d=[5 12] -> 2x4, row1 (5)=[1 0 1 0]. 2026-06-03: de2bi(d, [], base) with EMPTY width + custom base now works (was throwing on the [] arg): de2bi(10,[],3)=[1 0 1] (3 digits), de2bi(10,4,3)=[1 0 1 0]. Lifted to public C++ API numkit::comm::de2bi 2026-06.
